title: Model Reference Adaptive Controller
text: Discrete-time PID-based model reference adaptive control, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Proportional gain} sets the controller proportional gain, K p, {Integral gain} sets the controller integral gain, K i, {Derivative gain} sets the controller derivative gain, K d, {Anti-windup gain} sets the controller anti-windup gain, {Use filtered derivative} sets the filter, {Filter coefficient} sets the reference signal filter coefficient, {Control action upper limit} controls signal upper limit, u pid_max, {Control action lower limit} controls signal lower limit, u pid_min, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Model parameterization} sets the discrete or continuous model, {Discrete-time numerator} sets the discrete-time transfer function numerator, {Discrete-time denominator} sets the discrete-time transfer function denominator, {Discretization sample time} sets the sample time for discretization, {Continuous-time numerator} sets the continuous-time transfer function numerator, {Continuous-time denominator} sets the continuous-time transfer function denominator and {Learning rate} sets the γ. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: Controller proportional gain, K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: Controller integral gain, K i 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: Control signal upper limit, u pid_max 5 (default)

params.name: Control action lower limit
params.values: Control signal lower limit, u pid_min -5 (default)

params.name: Model parameterization
params.values: Discrete or continuous model option Discrete-time (default) | Continuous-time

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Sample time for discretization 0.01 (default) | -1 or positive number
